newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rupee ends up in kerb, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rupee ends up in kerb, seen stable.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee ended 0.13 up at 41.60 to the dollar in the kerb market on Monday amid higher dollar supplies from the Gulf, dealers said.
The rupee was likely to open stable on Tuesday, a dealer said.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rupee rate, last changed on June 28, was 40.4600/40.6623 against the dollar.
The premium on the foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at 2.80 percent compared to the opening at 3.35 percent.
